what_it_does: Redesigns how smartphone graphics are rendered to decouple the rendering pipeline from the display refresh timing. Traditional smartphones tightly link when graphics are computed to when they appear on screen, causing frame drops when rendering complex scenes takes longer than one screen refresh interval. This work separates these concerns by allowing rendering to complete asynchronously and using predictive scheduling to align finished frames with the next available display window, reducing frame drops and improving responsiveness for demanding visual effects.
